藏经阁残简 第十一章 暗流涌动陆明远窥伺（第1页）
两日光阴转瞬即逝，这两天沈砚表面上安分守己守在顶层阁楼，每日按时清扫整理书卷，一副麻木认命的模样。暗地里他寻遍藏书阁各个角落，挖掘出不少被遗忘的残简，日夜不停修复古籍、炼化道韵滋养自身。
他的修为稳步攀升至凝气七层初期，破碎的先天道基愈合九成，距离彻底复原只差最后一层薄纱，等到道基圆满，他的根基品质甚至会超越三年前的巅峰状态。
最令人忌惮的是他积攒的深厚底蕴，海量上古功法、神魂秘术加持之下，他的神魂厚度、道韵纯度、肉身根基全方位碾压同阶修士，就算是宗门内门核心弟子，单凭修为底子也远不及他。
同样是凝气七层，陆明远依靠宗门资源强行堆起修为，灵气虚浮、心浮气躁，道基还沾染了域外黑气，修行隐患重重。反观沈砚，每一分灵气都由上古道韵淬炼而来，心神澄澈稳定，根基扎实无瑕，二者高下如同云泥。
这天午后，一道白衣身影缓步走到西藏书阁门前，身姿挺拔，衣袍一尘不染，周身灵气肆意外放，正是如今风光无限的内门弟子陆明远。
他近日听闻两名外门弟子的回报，说藏书阁的废人沈砚疑似暗中藏有实力，心底不由得生出几分阴翳与狐疑。
陆明远想起三年前沈砚作为宗门天才，处处压自己一头的过往，哪怕对方道基破碎沦为杂役，他心底依旧藏着难以抹去的忌惮。在他心里，一个灵气断绝三年的废人不可能还有还手之力，那两名外门弟子多半是资质低劣，失手之后胡乱编造说辞。
可心底那一丝不安始终无法消散，陆明远打算亲自前往顶层阁楼窥伺一番，当面敲打羞辱沈砚。若是对方真的有复苏修为的迹象，他绝不留情，会再次出手打压，彻底碾碎沈砚翻身的希望。
陆明远迈步走入藏书阁，顺着木质阶梯登上顶层，一路外放自身凝气七层的灵气，带着内门弟子与生俱来的傲慢威压。阁楼木门虚掩，他一眼就看见窗边静静整理书卷的沈砚，一身陈旧灰袍，身形清瘦单薄，周身气息微弱平淡，看起来毫无修行力量。
见到这幅景象，陆明远心底最后一丝不安彻底烟消云散，暗自嘲讽自己多虑，眼前的沈砚依旧是那个毫无翻身可能的废物，之前的传闻不过是一场虚惊。
他双手背在身后，站在阁楼门口居高临下望着沈砚，故作温和地开口：“沈砚，许久未见，别来无恙？”
话语听似关切，内里却满是俯视的戏谑与压迫。沈砚背对着他，指尖轻轻抚过竹简纹路，身形没有半分转动，同时悄然运转《破妄文章》。
一眼之下，陆明远体内流转的灵气、心底暗藏的杂念、深藏的歹意全部清晰展露，沈砚更是清晰捕捉到萦绕在对方经脉深处一缕淡淡的域外黑气。
黑气浓度不高，却真实存在，这一刻沈砚心底瞬间冰寒彻骨，彻底看透当年的全部真相。
三年前他被陆明远栽赃陷害、打碎先天道基，从来都不是对方一时嫉妒心生歹念那么简单。陆明远早已被域外黑气侵染心智，当年的陷害、毁道，全部都是邪魔谋划已久的斩道布局。

Chapter 11 of the Fragments of the Sutra Pavilion: Lu Mingyuan is spying on the undercurrent (page 1)
Two days passed by in a blink of an eye. During these two days, Shen Yan seemed to be staying at home on the top floor of the attic, cleaning and sorting the books on time every day, looking numb and resigned to his fate. Secretly, he searched every corner of the library and unearthed many forgotten scraps. He repaired ancient books day and night, refining Taoism and nourishing himself.
His cultivation has steadily climbed to the early stage of the seventh level of Qi Condensation, and the broken innate Dao foundation has healed to 90%. He is only the last thin layer away from complete recovery. When the Dao foundation is complete, his foundation quality will even surpass the peak state three years ago.
The most fearsome thing is the profound foundation he has accumulated. With the blessing of a large number of ancient skills and soul secret techniques, the thickness of his soul, the purity of his Tao Yun, and the foundation of his body can crush monks of the same level in all aspects. Even the core disciples of the sect's inner sect are far inferior to him based on their cultivation base alone.
At the same seventh level of Qi Condensation, Lu Mingyuan relied on the sect's resources to forcibly build up his cultivation. His spiritual energy was weak, his heart was restless, and his Dao foundation was contaminated with black energy from outside the territory. There were many hidden dangers in his cultivation. Looking back at Shen Yan, every bit of spiritual energy is tempered by the ancient Taoist charm. His mind is clear and stable, and his foundation is solid and flawless. The two are as high as clouds and mud.
In the afternoon of this day, a figure in white walked slowly to the door of the Tibet Book Pavilion. He was tall and straight, his robes were spotless, and his spiritual energy was flowing wildly around him. He was none other than Lu Mingyuan, the now famous inner sect disciple.
He recently heard reports from two outer sect disciples that Shen Yan, the useless man in the library, was suspected of hiding some hidden strength, and he couldn't help but feel a bit of gloom and suspicion in his heart.
Lu Mingyuan thought of the past three years ago when Shen Yan, as a genius of the sect, had always suppressed him. Even if the other party's Daoji was broken and reduced to a handyman, he still had an indelible fear in his heart. In his heart, it was impossible for a cripple who had been cut off from his spiritual energy for three years to still be able to fight back. The two outer disciples were probably of low qualifications and made up random excuses after the mistake.
But the uneasiness in his heart could not dissipate. Lu Mingyuan planned to go to the top attic to spy on him and beat and humiliate Shen Yan in person. If the other party really shows signs of recovery, he will show no mercy and will suppress him again, completely crushing Shen Yan's hope of turning around.
Lu Mingyuan stepped into the library pavilion, climbed the wooden stairs to the top, and released his seventh level of spiritual energy along the way, bringing with him the inherent arrogance and coercion of an inner disciple. The wooden door of the attic was ajar, and at a glance he saw Shen Yan quietly sorting out books by the window. He was dressed in an old gray robe, with a thin figure and a weak and dull aura around him. He seemed to have no power to practice.
Seeing this scene, the last trace of uneasiness in Lu Mingyuan's heart completely disappeared, and he secretly laughed at himself for worrying too much. The Shen Yan in front of him was still the loser with no chance of turning around, and the previous rumors were just a false alarm.
With his hands behind his back, he stood at the door of the attic and looked down at Shen Yan. He pretended to be gentle and said, "Shen Yan, I haven't seen you for a long time. How are you?"
The words sounded concerned, but inside they were full of overlooking banter and oppression. Shen Yan's back was turned to him, and his fingertips gently stroked the lines of the bamboo slips. His body did not turn at all, and at the same time he quietly ran the "Permanent Article".
At a glance, the spiritual energy flowing in Lu Mingyuan's body, the hidden thoughts in his heart, and the hidden malice were all clearly revealed. Shen Yan could also clearly capture a faint wisp of extraterritorial black energy lingering deep in the opponent's meridians.
The concentration of black energy was not high, but it was real. At this moment, Shen Yan's heart was chilled to the bone, and he completely saw through the entire truth of that year.
Three years ago, he was framed by Lu Mingyuan and his innate foundation was shattered. It was never because of the other party's temporary jealousy and evil thoughts.So simple. Lu Mingyuan's mind has long been infected by the black energy from outside the territory. The frame-up and destruction of the path back then were all part of the evil's long-planned plan to destroy the path.
